name: Breezy westerly
story: A brisk westerly sets in across the island, white horses on the sound and a steady crosswind on the club's runway all afternoon. Good practice for the hands; the lee of the ridges is rough.
forecast: West 12-14 kt, gusting 20 in the afternoon. Moderate turbulence in the lee of the ridges. Fair-weather cumulus, base 1300 m. Wind easing after 20:00. Clear night.
